name: TiddlyWiki5 substitution
comment:
Text replacement, which a define body takes and the other three definition bodies do not. widget.js gates both placeholder forms behind isMacroDefinition.

This stands as a grammar of its own so one registration reaches every scope that colours wikitext. A TextMate injection keys on a scope name, and a grammar wrapping another carries a different one — so an injection written inside the base grammar fires only there, and each wrapper had to copy it. A copy forgotten loses colouring and says nothing; a registration forgotten leaves this grammar reaching nobody, which a gate reads at once.
